runtime_config.gateway_hint: Only used in Gateway mode. Every field is optional — a blank field is inherited from the daemon host's gateway config (`~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`, `gateway` section). A saved token is the exception: leaving it blank keeps the saved value.
runtime_config.host_hint: The gateway address, from your deployment admin. Blank inherits the host's config.
runtime_config.token_hint: Issued by the gateway — get it from your deployment admin or the gateway host's config. When none is set, blank inherits.
runtime_config.token_hint_saved: A token is saved — leaving this field blank keeps it. Enter a new value to replace it.
